name: Modules and Fields | A CRM Admin profile gives module and field administration inside Desk
html:
Summary

A user who has the Desk Agent profile in Desk and the CRM Admin profile in CRM gets CRM Admin's metadata permissions inside Desk, so an agent can open and change Setup → Modules and Fields.

Steps to reproduce

  1. Give a user the Desk Agent profile (Desk) and the CRM Admin profile (CRM).

  2. Sign in to Desk as that user.

  3. Open Setup → Modules and Fields.

  4. Call GET /api/v1/iam/me/permissions with header x-app-key: desk.

Expected result

Only Desk Agent permissions apply in Desk (metadata.records.access, metadata.records.manage). Modules and Fields says "You don't have permission to view this page".

Actual result

The page opens with the full module table and "Create New Module". The permissions response contains CRM Admin's metadata permissions.

Request

GET /api/v1/iam/me/permissions  (x-app-key: desk)

Response

200 — includes metadata.modules.manage, metadata.fields.manage_permissions, metadata.capabilities.manage, metadata.views.manage, metadata.integrations.manage, metadata.records.convert. GET /api/v1/iam/profiles/{desk_agent_id}/effective lists only metadata.records.access and metadata.records.manage.

Evidence

Attached: the annotated image (TAVI vs Zoho, numbered boxes and an expected-vs-actual table) and the original screenshot.

Environment

staging-desk.taviportal.com (tenant NDC-Staging), TAVI Desk web app, headless Chromium, 5–6 Oct 2026; Gmail test user with Desk Agent + CRM Admin.

Additional notes

  • Severity: Critical. Spec row SEC-1 in docs/desk-modules-fields/spec-desk-modules-fields.md (QA repository), functional run 1.

  • MF-11 (Access Control picker lists CRM users) is the same family: Desk reads CRM data.

  • Full bug report: docs/desk-modules-fields/desk-modules-fields-bug-report.md (MF-01).

name: Modules and Fields | Profiles chosen in the Create Module dialog are not applied
html:
Summary

When a module is created with "Module Permission" limited to some profiles, the limit is silently lost: the request that saves it returns 404 and the module stays open to everyone.

Steps to reproduce

  1. Setup → Modules and Fields → Create New Module.

  2. Name "QA MF Closed", Module Permission: tick only Desk Administrator → Create.

  3. Sign in as a Desk Agent.

  4. Open the "+" create menu and the module page; create a record.

Expected result

The agent does not see the module and cannot read or create its records. If saving the permission fails, the dialog shows an error.

Actual result

No error is shown. The agent sees the module (sidebar and "+" menu), lists its records and creates a record. Access Control on the module still shows "All Users".

Request

PUT /api/v1/modules/{module_id}/permissions
{"profileIds":["44444444-4444-4444-4444-444444444401"]}

Response

404 {"success":false,"error":{"code":"NOT_FOUND","message":"The requested resource was not found."}}. As the agent afterwards: GET /modules/{module_id}/records → 200; POST /modules/{module_id}/records → 201.

Evidence

Attached: the annotated image (TAVI vs Zoho, numbered boxes and an expected-vs-actual table) and the original screenshot.

Environment

staging-desk.taviportal.com (tenant NDC-Staging), TAVI Desk web app, headless Chromium, 6–7 Oct 2026; tenant owner creates the module; Desk Agent account (mahmoud.mohamed1, profile lowered for the test) checks access.

Additional notes

name: Modules and Fields | A saved field's data type can be changed
html:
Summary

An existing field can be switched to another data type through the API; existing values are left unconverted.

Steps to reproduce

  1. Create a single-line field and save a record with text in it.

  2. Send the request below to change its type to number.

  3. Read the field and the record.

Expected result

Refused (Zoho: "the field type cannot be changed").

Actual result

200; the field is now a number field and the old text value stays as text.

Request

PUT /api/v1/modules/{module_id}/fields/{field_id}
{"fieldName":"qa_sl","labels":{"en":"QA MF sl"},"datatypeKey":"number","required":false,"unique":false,"uniquePeerModuleIds":[]}

Response

200 OK — datatypeKey "number".

Evidence

API only — see the request and response above.

Environment

name: Modules and Fields | A required field can be set to "Don't Show"
html:
Summary

Field Permissions lets an admin hide a required field from a profile; that profile can then no longer create any record.

Steps to reproduce

  1. Module → Fields → Field Permissions → profile Desk Agent.

  2. Set Name (required) to "Don't Show" → Save.

  3. As a Desk Agent, create a record (form or API).

Expected result

"Don't Show" disabled for required fields, or Save refused with a message.

Actual result

Saved ("3 field permissions updated"). Every agent create then fails with 422 "One or more fields in the payload are not writable for your profile."

Request

POST /api/v1/modules/{module_id}/field-permissions
{"fieldId":"{name_field_id}","profileId":"44444444-4444-4444-4444-444444444402","permission":"hidden"}
then as the agent: POST /api/v1/modules/{module_id}/records {"data":[{"field":"name","value":{"kind":"string","value":"QA MF agent rec"}}]}

Response

field-permissions → 200/201. Agent record → 422 "One or more fields in the payload are not writable for your profile."

name: Modules and Fields | Access Control picker lists CRM users and profiles instead of Desk ones
html:
Summary

The "Select principals" picker used by module Access Control and Layout Permissions loads CRM users and profiles, so a layout or module cannot be limited to a Desk profile or a Desk agent.

Steps to reproduce

  1. Open a layout → Layout settings → Layout Permissions (or a module → Access Control).

  2. Choose Selected Users → Select principals.

  3. Switch the kind to Profiles; then search Users for a Desk agent.

Expected result

Desk profiles (Desk Administrator, Supervisor, Agent, Light Agent, Reviewer) and Desk agents.

Actual result

Profiles: CRM Admin, Manager, Supervisor, test, User. The Desk agent mahmoud.mohamed1@taviportal.com is not found.

Request

GET /api/v1/iam/users?app_key=crm  (sent by the picker; also GET /iam/profiles, /iam/org-units)

Response

200 — CRM users only. Note: a limit set through the API with the Desk Agent profile id is enforced correctly (G10 passed).

name: Modules and Fields | Field dependency rules (SHOW / REQUIRE) are saved but not applied
html:
Summary

Field Dependency rules are stored and listed, but neither the record form nor the record API applies them.

Steps to reproduce

  1. Layout QA MF L-Agent: add rules "When QA MF e2e_kind = Hardware → Show QA MF e2e_serial" and "→ Require QA MF e2e_serial".

  2. As a Desk Agent: "+" → QA MF Open1 → choose layout QA MF L-Agent.

  3. Look at QA MF e2e_serial before choosing a kind; choose Hardware; leave serial empty; Save.

Expected result

Serial hidden until Hardware is chosen; then required; Save blocked. The API refuses the same record.

Actual result

Serial is visible before Hardware; the record saves with serial empty ("Record saved successfully"); the API returns 201. Same on module QA MF Deps (SHOW qa_b / REQUIRE qa_c when ctrl = Z).

Request

PUT /api/v1/modules/{module_id}/layouts/{layout_id}  (…"dependencies":[{"id":"{uuid}","parentFieldId":"{kind_id}","parentValues":["Hardware"],"action":"SHOW","childFieldIds":["{serial_id}"]},{"id":"{uuid}","parentFieldId":"{kind_id}","parentValues":["Hardware"],"action":"REQUIRE","childFieldIds":["{serial_id}"]}])
then as the agent: POST /api/v1/modules/{module_id}/records {"data":[{"field":"name","value":{"kind":"string","value":"QA MF E2E hw no serial"}},{"field":"qa_e2e_kind","value":{"kind":"string","value":"Hardware"}}],"layout_id":"{layout_id}"}

Response

Layout PUT → 200 (2 rules stored). Record → 201 Created.

Evidence

Attached: the annotated image (TAVI vs Zoho, numbered boxes and an expected-vs-actual table) and the original screenshot.

Environment

staging-desk.taviportal.com (tenant NDC-Staging), TAVI Desk web app, headless Chromium, 6–7 Oct 2026; tenant owner sets the rules; Desk Agent account (mahmoud.mohamed1, profile lowered for the test) creates the record.

name: Modules and Fields | Department storage has no effect on records
html:
Summary

A module created with Module Data Storage = Department stores records without a department, and every user sees every record.

Steps to reproduce

  1. Create New Module "QA MF DeptMod" with Module Data Storage = Department.

  2. Create records: plain, with header x-department-id, and with department_id in the body.

  3. List the records as an agent who belongs only to "QA MF Dept", and as an admin.

Expected result

Each record belongs to a department; users see only their departments' records.

Actual result

All creates return 201; records carry no department field; the agent and the admin see the same 4 records; the list is the same with or without a department header.

Request

POST /api/v1/teamspaces/{teamspace_id}/modules {"moduleKey":"qa_mf_deptmod","labels":{"en":"QA MF DeptMod"},"pluralForm":"QA MF DeptMod","singularForm":"QA MF DeptMod1","storageScope":"department"}
POST /api/v1/modules/{module_id}/records {"data":[{"field":"name","value":{"kind":"string","value":"QA MF dept rec hdr"}}]}  (header x-department-id: {department_id})
POST /api/v1/modules/{module_id}/records {"data":[…],"department_id":"{department_id}"}

Response

Module 201 (storageScope "department"). Records 201 ×3, no department in the stored record. GET records → same 3–4 records for every user and header.

Evidence

name: Modules and Fields | File and image upload restrictions are not enforced
html:
Summary

A File Upload field limited to PDF and 1 MB accepts other file types and larger files, on the form and through the API, with no message.

Steps to reproduce

  1. Create File Upload field "QA MF file" with allowed extensions [pdf], max 1 MB, and Image Upload "QA MF img" with [png], 1 MB.

  2. On the create form upload qa-mf.txt, qa-mf.png and a 2.2 MB PDF to QA MF file.

  3. Send the API request below.

Expected result

Wrong type and too-large files refused with a message; the API refuses them too.

Actual result

The form takes the .txt and .png with no message and shows no message for the 2.2 MB file; the API returns 201. (An SVG with a script did not run.)

Request

POST /api/v1/modules/{module_id}/records
{"data":[{"field":"name","value":{"kind":"string","value":"QA MF upload api"}},{"field":"qa_file","value":{"kind":"object","properties":{"url":{"kind":"string","value":"x"},"mime":{"kind":"string","value":"text/plain"},"name":{"kind":"string","value":"qa-mf.txt"},"size":{"kind":"number","value":22}}}}],"layout_id":"{default_layout_id}"}

201 Created.
